title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.09.5
notes:
- Added per-device MIDI controller modes for basic Mackie Control (MCU) transport and mixer input, with presets for MCU-capable Komplete Kontrol, Arturia KeyLab and Behringer X-Touch models, plus Korg nanoKONTROL2 factory CC mappings. Hardware mode must match; HUI, NKS browsing, displays and motor-fader feedback are not included.
- Ctrl/Cmd+Shift-drag selects clips and notes with a rectangle in the Playlist and Piano Roll. Drag from Playlist headers to select whole tracks' clips, or Piano Roll keys to select whole pitch rows across time.
- Fixed Piano Roll key highlights remaining lit after note audition ends.
- Multiple clips dragged from the Clip Picker are placed on consecutive Playlist tracks at the same timeline position.
- Audio Timing edits can be auditioned through normal Playlist playback before Apply. The timing editor now shares Vocal Tuning's panel styling and layout.
- Added Mixer group locks to protect organization and routing while allowing normal mixing. Right-click a channel padlock to lock its group; red indicates a group lock and yellow an individual channel lock.
- Added batch Mixer track insertion with confirmation, support for up to 255 visible inserts, F2 renaming and a confirmation before resetting tracks and removing their effects.
- Improved Mixer routing hit areas to avoid changing the selected channel while making sends.
- Simplified Settings > Controls and reduced repeated work when searching and editing action assignments.
- Removed the in-app Feature Voting, forum and Community Samples tabs. Existing downloaded samples remain available. Help > Change Log now opens the complete searchable history offline.

https://michaellanemusic.de/lemon-studio/
